errors.what: Initial relative-path commands failed because bash cwd is the heavy/ subdir, not repo root
errors.recovered_by: switching to absolute paths anchored at repo root for all subsequent commands

problems_and_friction: The bash working directory resets to the heavy/ subdir between calls rather than the repo root, so the prompt's repo-relative paths initially errored; resolved by using absolute paths throughout.
context_understood: First analyst in the H2 CRM-recommendation chain: I merge-patched my role-namespaced market findings (TAM, segment, growth, incumbent share, buyer priorities) into the data-only doc.clan with the handoff note as rationale, leaving pricing for the next hop.
